items.title: Congress raises over Rs 27.5 million for Bhotekoshi flood victims
items.summary: Kathmandu, October 5 The Nepali Congress has collected more than Rs 27.5 million to provide relief and support to families affected by the flood in the Bhotekoshi River. items.title: Govt prepares to revise road and bridge designs after flood disasters
items.summary: Kathmandu, October 5 The government has begun preparations to revise road and bridge designs following major flood and landslide disasters in Rasuwa, Bhotekoshi and Kaligandaki. Officials from the Ministry of Physical Infrastructure Development said the government is preparing to establish a Maintenance and Disaster Resilience Unit and revise design codes for roads and bridges. items.title: Nepal scales back flood search as Rs559b reconstruction effort begins
items.summary: The government has suspended search and rescue operations for Bhotekoshi-Trishuli floods except in emergencies, directing authorities to accelerate reconstruction and rehabilitation in flood-hit areas.
